title: The Bodleian First Folio — diplomatic digital edition of the Bodleian First Folio (Arch. G c.7)
notes:
Diplomatic transcriptions of the plays in the Bodleian Library's copy of the Shakespeare First Folio (Arch. G c.7), encoded in TEI P5-conformant XML with published transcription guidelines; page images and TEI XML downloadable under CC BY 3.0 (the specific download page was not verified in this run). Single-work edition, but a significant scholarly diplomatic edition from a major research library (project since 2013).

Justification: Found via the Folgerpedia list of digital editions of English Renaissance drama. A significant, freely accessible TEI diplomatic edition of a key 1623 printed work within the 1450–1700 window; not in the catalogue.
Found at: https://folgerpedia.folger.edu/Digital_editions_of_English_Renaissance_drama
